cv.name: Bram Kuijpers
cv.headline: Junior Construction Manager / Werkvoorbereider – Residential & Timber Construction
cv.summary: Civil engineer with three years on residential construction sites in Amsterdam and Almere. Has worked as work planner and assistant site manager on timber-frame and concrete housing projects and now looks for a construction manager role.

experience.title: Asst. Uitvoerder / Jr. Construction Mgr
bullets: Day-to-day site coordination for 64 timber-frame apartments in Amsterdam-Noord
Plan subcontractors weekly and run the morning site meetings
Keep the site diary, safety inspections (VCA) and snag lists in Dalux
Handled two weeks of independent site management during the site manager's leave

experience.title: Werkvoorbereider (trainee grade B)
bullets: Prepared purchase orders and quantity take-offs for prefab elements
Updated the construction schedule in MS Project after design changes

experience.title: Graduation intern – BIM
bullets: Built Revit models for clash checks between structure and installations

education.details: Graduation project: planning of prefab timber housing
